question: Hunter Commission, 1882 was related to development of ________ in colonial India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** education.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Hunter Commission (1882)** endorsed the Despatch of 1854 with greater emphasis** on primary education.**
 
• The Hunter Commission of 1882 was** presided by Sir William Hunter and was appointed by Lord Ripon, the then Viceroy of India.**
 
• **The other Hunter Commission of 1920 **was appointed by the then Secretary of State for India, Edwin Montagu.
 
• Charles Wood was the President of the Board of Control of the English East India Company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sir William Hunter was an Indian Civil Service officer and a member of the Executive Council of the Viceroy.**
 
• The following were the main objectives :
 
• Consider different aspects of education in India, **paying particular attention to primary education.**
 
• Enquire into the execution of Wood’s Despatch of 1854 and suggest ways to improve outcomes of the same.
 
• Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856) was the Governor-General of India under whom the** first railway line connecting Bombay to Thane was laid in 1853.**
 
• Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856) also passed the** Post office Act in 1854.**
 
• During Lord Dalhousie's (1848-1856) tenure, **Widow Remarriage Act was taken place in 1856.**
